# Corpus index

The front door for the `presentation-sites` monorepo. How this corpus works and
the retrieval budget: [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md). How work routes:
[routing.md](routing.md). Chronological changes: [log.md](log.md).

New here? Read [wiki/overview.md](wiki/overview.md), then
[wiki/status.md](wiki/status.md).

## Wiki

<!-- CATALOG:START — generated by lint.sh --index; do not hand-edit -->
- [architecture](wiki/architecture.md) — How this workspace is put together — the sites/ + packages/ layout, the per-site docs-sites, what @sites/kit shares, the shared Astro/Tailwind shape, the mock-vs-real image pipeline, the gitignored real-data split, and where deploy lives.
- [decisions-house-style](wiki/decisions-house-style.md) — The house style, formatted and checked, with Astro (2026-11-11) - Prettier at width 120 with the Astro plugin, the vendored house-style ESLint config plus a local Astro layer, the tsconfig flags each site takes, the npm run check gate and its fast subset, what stays outside, and the exceptions with what removes each. Read before changing a lint, format or typecheck setting.
- [decisions-ui](wiki/decisions-ui.md) — The calls about what the sites' React islands depend on - one icon family inlined at build time (Phosphor), and Base UI under the four phone menus (Dialog, then Drawer), with the measured JS each costs. Split out of decisions.md on 2026-10-23.
- [decisions](wiki/decisions.md) — Locked structural choices for this monorepo — self-contained sites, deploy living elsewhere, env-driven base paths, the mock/real image split, and gitignored business data. The islands' icon and Base UI calls are on decisions-ui.md, the house style and its checks on decisions-house-style.md. Do not relitigate without a log entry.
- [design-styles](wiki/design-styles.md) — Where the repo's design-language reference lives and how to reuse it — fourteen per-style dossiers under sites/design-study/docs/styles/, each carrying a CSS image-treatment recipe and prompt descriptors for generating imagery in that style.
- [open-questions](wiki/open-questions.md) — Nothing open as of 2026-10-07. The briefs-lifecycle and demo-sites questions were answered on 2026-10-06 and churchix got its corpus on 2026-10-07; see decisions.md.
- [overview](wiki/overview.md) — What presentation-sites is — a monorepo of independent Romanian marketing sites, who each one is for, and what lives at the top level.
- [site-patterns](wiki/site-patterns.md) — The as-built patterns several sites share, from the 2026-09-27 improvements audit fixes (2026-10-01/02) and later rounds. Social cards as screenshotted HTML, opening hours from one HOURS list, the phone menus on Base UI and how a link closes them, pausing a WebGL hero off-screen, design-study's carousel keys, the saloon bots webhook body cap, and the dependency hygiene rules (no dead Vite overrides, audit at the root and in churchix). Read before copying a fix from one site to another.
- [status](wiki/status.md) — Dated snapshot (2026-11-02) of where each site stands, the recent work per area, what waits on a deploy, and what this root corpus does versus the per-site docs. The living dashboard — start here after a break.

## Per-site docs (this corpus links down, it does not duplicate)

Every project has the same shape: `README.md` + `PRODUCT.md` + `DESIGN.md` at
its root, everything else under `docs/`. churchix keeps its knowledge and work in
its own `corpus/`, and only the design source and ADRs in `docs/`.

| Site | Entry point |
|---|---|
| saloon | [saloon/README.md](../sites/saloon/README.md) · [docs/STATUS.md](../sites/saloon/docs/STATUS.md) |
| auto-service | [auto-service/README.md](../sites/auto-service/README.md) · [docs/STATUS.md](../sites/auto-service/docs/STATUS.md) |
| subcort | [subcort/README.md](../sites/subcort/README.md) |
| tractari | [tractari/README.md](../sites/tractari/README.md) |
| design-study | [design-study/README.md](../sites/design-study/README.md) · [docs/styles/](../sites/design-study/docs/styles/README.md) |
| churchix | [churchix/CLAUDE.md](../churchix/CLAUDE.md) · [corpus/](../churchix/corpus/index.md) · [status](../churchix/corpus/wiki/status.md) |
